name: openzoo
description: OpenAI-compatible provider with no signup: any API key value works and usage is paid per call (card or x402). Hosted at api.openzoo.fun; a local gateway is available via `npx openzoo`.

env_vars.name: OPENZOO_HOST
env_vars.description: Base URL of the OpenZoo endpoint (use http://localhost:8402 for the local `npx openzoo` gateway)

setup_steps: No signup needed — enter any API key value (e.g. sk-openzoo) as OPENZOO_API_KEY.
Optionally set OPENZOO_HOST to http://localhost:8402 after running `npx openzoo` locally.
